cards.name: Laziness
cards.rules_text: No ability. One of five vanilla commons, one per color, each worth a flat 4.

cards.name: Charity
cards.rules_text: After playing this mood, you may play an additional mood this turn.

cards.name: Superiority
cards.rules_text: While in play, this mood's value is 7 if you have more moods than each other player.

cards.name: Serenity
cards.rules_text: While in play, this mood's value is 6 if you have an even number of moods, including this one.

cards.name: Rage
cards.rules_text: After playing this mood, you may put all other moods with a value of 3 or less into the discard pile.

cards.name: Harmony
cards.rules_text: After playing this mood, you may play an additional mood this turn from the discard pile.

cards.name: Betrayal
cards.rules_text: After playing this mood, give one of your moods to another player. After scoring, that mood becomes yours again if it's still in play.

cards.name: Indifference
cards.rules_text: No ability. One of five vanilla commons, one per color, each worth a flat 4.

cards.name: Cheer
cards.rules_text: After playing this mood, you may discard a card from your hand with a 0, 2, 4, or 6 in its top right corner. If you do, this mood's value becomes 5.

cards.name: Doubt
cards.rules_text: After playing this mood, you may reveal any number of cards from your hand and put them on the bottom of the deck, then draw that many cards. During the next round, players can't play moods that share a color with any of the revealed cards.

cards.name: Kindness
cards.rules_text: After playing this mood, you may play an additional mood this turn if it has a 1, 3, or 5 in its top right corner.

cards.name: Meekness
cards.rules_text: After playing this mood, suppress all moods with a value of 5 or more. Those moods remain suppressed for as long as you have this mood.

cards.name: Self-Loathing
cards.rules_text: To play this card, put one or more of your moods into the discard pile. If you can't do that, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Panic
cards.rules_text: After playing this mood, choose up to two players. For each chosen player, put one of their moods into their hand. You can't put this mood into your hand this way.
